data.desc: Seanergy Maritime Holdings Corp. is a prominent pure-play Capesize shipping company publicly listed in the U.S. Seanergy provides marine dry bulk transportation services through a modern fleet of Capesize vessels. The Company owns or operates under finance leases 19 vessels (2 Newcastlemax and 17 Capesize) with an average age of approximately 15.3 years and an aggregate cargo carrying capacity of 3,463,843 dwt. Upon the sale of the M/Vs Dukeship and Friendship and the delivery of the nine newbuilding vessels and three secondhand vessels, the Company will own or operate under finance leases 29 vessels (5 Newcastlemax and 24 Capesize), with an aggregate cargo carrying capacity of approximately 5,367,438 dwt. The Company is incorporated in the Republic of the Marshall Islands and has executive offices in Glyfada, Greece. The Company's common shares trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol 'SHIP'.
